description: DEP Reported Sanitary Sewer Overflows is a dataset listed in Montgomery County open data portal (data.montgomerycountymd.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Montgomery County. Sanitary sewer overflows reported to the Department of Environmental Protection by the Washington Suburban Sanitary Commission or individuals in the County. Update Frequency - Daily. Coverage: Montgomery County, Maryland. The portal files it under the category Environment. Its tags are illegal dumping, dep, department of environmental protection, sanitary sewer overflow, sanitation. The table has 7 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Environmental Protection. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-montgomerycountymd-gov-portal.
